leaves.title: User edits autosave without pressing save

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN a user stops typing for 2s THEN the edit is saved as a draft with no manual save

leaves.title: Autosave queues writes while offline and flushes on reconnect

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN edits are made offline and the connection returns THEN the draft is saved
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: e2e: go offline, edit, reconnect, assert draft saved
